final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.arcref, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as proportion FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3) SELECT s3.arcref, s3.cnt, s3.proportion, s3.proportion - s4.avg_proportion as diff FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_proportion IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
